sources.summary: From lighting and materials to colors, textures, and forms, every design decision shapes how people perceive, experience, and interact with architecture . In contemporary interiors, these choices are no longer understood as merely aesthetic or functional, influencing comfort, behavior, mood, and even the way users evaluate the quality of a space. Bathroom design , in particular, now creates carefully curated environments with a distinct identity, where every element contributes to the overall spatial experience.
